QuestInfo.name: Bavan the Watchman
QuestInfo.0: Go talk to #b#p2152016##k in disguise as a Black Wings member and get some info.
QuestInfo.1: #p2152016#'s job is to supervise the other watchmen in town, but he has higher ambitions. Go get the item he wants.\n\n#i4033122# #t4033122# #b#c4033122# / 1#k
QuestInfo.2: #p2152016# really wants the money and power that come with being a Black Wings officer, but he doesn't actually seem to understand what it would entail.

0.0: Nom-nom-nom, who are you, with your fancy sleek clothes? You look a little well-off to be one of the new recruits. Perhaps you're one of the officer's children, working your way up!
0.1: Maybe I'll tell you a little secret on advancing through the ranks. You'll have to help me first. It's a little thing. Just bring a #b#t4033122##k from a #r#o1150002##k.

yes.0: You'll find a #o1150002# or two if you just head #beast#k. It's called the Serpent Path after all. You'll find a nice bag if you keep whacking those snakes.

no.0: Have it your way, rookie. You can wallow as a lowly watchman forever.

1.0: Look at the luster on that #t4033122#! Lady #p2154002# is sure to love it! Oh, your tip. Yes, the fastest way to get ahead is through bribery! Just give money and gifts to your betters until they give you what you want!
1.1: I was a skinny little street rat like yourself before I started bribing my way to the top. Just look at me now! I report all of the town's happenings straight up the chain, no matter how trivial they may seem. I'm on my way to the top!
1.2: I've heard that the upper echelon of our organization are rolling in benefits! Money, honor, UNDERLINGS! Think of the chefs I could hire! You never have to do a day of work in your life and they just keep paying you!

yes.0: I'd even get to leave #m310000000# and travel the world. I don't know all the details, but I know it's great! Money is all you need, no?
yes.1: #b(Bavan's mind is on his own promotions. I should find another trail to chase.)

item.0: I hear you can get a #t4033122# from a #o1150002#, if you are lucky...
